desc:
You're visiting your uncle's remote lakehouse for summer vacation, but a wrong turn leaves you lost and alone. The property is eerily quiet, everyone's gone missing, and something feels seriously off about the place.

🤝 The game can be played with up to 6 players, so invite your friends!

🕹️ CONTROLS:
💻 PC: Sprint (Left Shift) Crouch (C)
📱 Phone: Sprint (Sprint Button) Crouch (Crouch Button)
🎮 Console: Sprint (L1) Crouch (B)

WARNING: Contains Flashing Lights and Loud Jumpscares!

LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ the game for more ENDINGS!
